user.title: UCANESS portal login
user.description: UNOFFICIAL integration. Readings only by default; the inverter is controlled (work mode, charge windows) only if 'Write allowed' is enabled in the options. The EMS ID is shown in the portal 'Details' panel.

reauth_confirm.title: UCANESS re-authentication
reauth_confirm.description: The session was rejected. Enter your UCANESS password again.

error.device_not_found: No device found with this EMS ID.

init.title: UCANESS options
init.description: The integration comes with an application key provided by UCanpower: leave both key fields empty to use it. Fill in a personal key and secret only if UCanpower gave you one; it then takes precedence. To go back to the provided key, empty the key field. Leave the secret empty to keep the one already saved. 'Write allowed' lets Home Assistant change the work mode (self-consumption or time-of-use) and the charge windows, nothing else.

data.write_enabled: Write allowed (work mode and charge windows only)

tester_api.name: Test the UCanpower API
tester_api.description: Read-only check of the signed third-party API: device identifier, inverter model, work mode and windows. Nothing is sent to the inverter.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: UCANESS entry to use (optional if only one device).

definir_plages_charge.name: Set charge windows
definir_plages_charge.description: Programs up to 3 charge windows of the time-of-use mode (HHMM). Other charge windows and all discharge windows are cleared. Requires 'Write allowed'.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: UCANESS entry to use (optional if only one device).

plages.name: Windows
plages.description: List of {debut, fin} in HHMM, for example 2300 to 2359 then 0000 to 0130.

definir_mode.name: Set work mode
definir_mode.description: Switches the inverter to self-consumption or time-of-use. Backup is not allowed. Requires 'Write allowed'.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: UCANESS entry to use (optional if only one device).

optimiser_charge.name: Plan charging (dynamic tariff)
optimiser_charge.description: Computes, without sending anything to the inverter, up to 3 grid charge windows that minimise the cost under a variable price, from prices, expected consumption and solar forecast.

prix.name: Prices
prix.description: List of {debut, prix} (or {start, price}) in EUR/kWh incl. taxes, hourly or quarter-hourly.

conso.name: Consumption
conso.description: 24 values (kWh per hour of the day) or a list of {debut, kwh}.

solaire.name: Solar forecast
solaire.description: Solcast detailedHourly / detailedForecast list, or {debut, kwh}.

plancher_pct.name: SOC floor
plancher_pct.description: SOC below which the inverter stops discharging.

puissance_charge_kw.name: Grid charge power
puissance_charge_kw.description: Power actually observed during a grid charge window.

marge_pct.name: Margin
marge_pct.description: Increase applied to the expected consumption.

charge_interdite.name: Charging forbidden
charge_interdite.description: True when the battery is below 0 °C.

reserve.name: Backup reserve
reserve.description: {debut, fin, soc_pct}: minimum SOC to keep between two times (risk of grid outage).

seuil_gain_eur.name: Minimum gain
seuil_gain_eur.description: Below this estimated gain, no window is planned.

valeur_stock_eur_kwh.name: Value of stored energy
valeur_stock_eur_kwh.description: EUR per kWh left in the battery at the end of the horizon (default: cheapest price / efficiency).

max_plages.name: Maximum windows
max_plages.description: Charge windows available on the inverter (3).

plages_depuis_plan.name: Windows from an external plan
plages_depuis_plan.description: Turns a battery plan from another optimiser (EMHASS: P_batt < 0 = charge, P_grid > 0 = import) into up to 3 charge windows. Nothing is sent to the inverter.

plan.name: Plan
plan.description: List of {debut, charge_reseau_kw} or EMHASS items {date, p_batt, p_grid} in W.

seuil_kw.name: Threshold
seuil_kw.description: Grid charge power below which a slot is ignored.

max_plages.name: Maximum windows
max_plages.description: Charge windows available on the inverter (3).

evaluer_offres.name: Evaluate electricity offers
evaluer_offres.description: Calculation only: estimated yearly cost of each offer on the measured hourly grid import (battery already deducted), ranking by cost, advice on the subscribed power. Plans: base and hphc. Nothing is subscribed, nothing is sent to the inverter.

offres.name: Offers
offres.description: List of {nom, fournisseur, formule (base or hphc), abonnement_eur_an {kVA: € incl. tax}, prix_kwh {base} or {hp, hc} in € incl. tax, plages_hc [{debut, fin}], weekend_hc, source, date_prix}.

contrat_actuel.name: Current contract
contrat_actuel.description: Same shape as an offer: reference for the yearly difference.

soutirage.name: Grid import
soutirage.description: List of {debut, kwh}: energy taken from the grid, one value per hour.

puissance_kva.name: Subscribed power
puissance_kva.description: Power of the contract, in kVA.

jours_non_ouvres.name: Public holidays
jours_non_ouvres.description: Dates counted as a weekend for offers with fully off-peak weekends.

puissances_max_kva.name: Peak powers
puissances_max_kva.description: One peak power per day, in kVA, for the advice on the subscribed power.

mesure_fine.name: Peaks read from the meter
mesure_fine.description: Turn on if the peak powers come from the meter itself and not from an estimate.

capacite_utile_kwh.name: Usable battery capacity
capacite_utile_kwh.description: Capacity above the floor. When given, night charging is estimated for off-peak offers (upper estimate).

rendement_pct.name: Efficiency
rendement_pct.description: Battery efficiency one way (charge or discharge).

recharge_deja_active.name: Night charging already active
recharge_deja_active.description: Turn on if the house already charges the battery off-peak: the measured grid import already reflects it.

etape_connexion.title: UCANESS: the battery is not responding
etape_connexion.description:
The integration no longer receives readings from "{appareil}". Nothing can be computed without them.

Check the inverter's Internet connection, then [open the integration]({lien}).

etape_packages.title: UCANESS: install the control packages
etape_packages.description:
"{appareil}" is connected, but the control packages are not installed yet: they decide each evening how much to charge at night.

[Installation guide]({lien}). Control always starts in simulation: nothing is sent to the inverter.

etape_entites.title: UCANESS: some readings are not found by the control packages
etape_entites.description:
The packages read the battery under fixed names. Missing: {entites}.

Rename the matching entities in [Settings > Entities]({lien}) ("Entity ID" field). On a new installation these names are given automatically.

init.title: Your battery
init.description:
The inverter reports {modules} battery module(s). With 5.12 kWh modules, that is {proposition} kWh: confirm or correct.

The floor is the level below which the battery no longer discharges (watch the lowest level reached on a night without charging). The charge power is what you observe during a grid charge. Both can be refined later.

abort.entree_absente: This battery is no longer configured.

init.title: Your electricity contract
init.description: This information is on your bill. With a contract without off-peak hours, choose "Base" and leave the off-peak fields aside.

data.prix_hp: Peak price per kWh (or single price)
data.hc_jours_non_ouvres: Weekends and public holidays fully off-peak

bilan.title: Charging at night pays off for you
bilan.description:
Each kWh charged off-peak and used at peak time saves about {gain} cents (battery efficiency counted at {rendement} % each way).

Control will charge at night, just enough to last until the sun takes over. Submit to save your contract.

bilan_non_rentable.title: Charging at night does not pay off for you
bilan_non_rentable.description:
With these prices, each kWh charged off-peak and used at peak time would lose about {gain} cents (battery efficiency counted at {rendement} % each way).

Control will not plan any grid charge; your battery keeps storing your solar production. Submit to save your contract.

bilan_base.title: Contract without off-peak hours
bilan_base.description: With a single price, charging the battery from the grid brings nothing: control will not plan any night charge. Your battery keeps storing your solar production. Submit to save your contract.

abort.entree_absente: This battery is no longer configured.

etape_jours_ouvres.title: UCANESS: add working days
etape_jours_ouvres.description:
Control tells weekdays from weekends and public holidays: consumption and, depending on the contract, off-peak hours differ.

[Add the Workday integration]({lien}) and choose your country.

etape_prevision_solaire.title: UCANESS: add the solar production forecast
etape_prevision_solaire.description:
To charge only what is needed, control needs today's and tomorrow's expected production. Without a forecast, no charge is planned.

Install the Solcast PV Forecast integration from the Marketplace (community content, not checked by Home Assistant), then [set it up]({lien}).

etape_notifications.title: UCANESS: choose where to be notified
etape_notifications.description:
Optional. To be told about a battery fault or a failed programming.

Fill in "Alertes : service de notification" in [Settings > Helpers]({lien}), for example `mobile_app_my_phone`.

etape_solaire.title: UCANESS: do you have solar panels?

init.title: Solar panels
init.description:
The inverter has not measured any solar production yet. A battery can work with or without panels.

With panels, the battery first stores your production, and control only charges the remainder at night. Without panels, it buys electricity at the cheapest hours to use it at the expensive ones: everything then depends on your contract, which the assistant reviews in the next step.

data.solaire: Solar panels are connected to this inverter

abort.entree_absente: This battery is no longer configured.
